Thanks Kim — good catch. A couple quick operational notes (so we don't hit this again mid-demo):
- The GCal anchor in the ICS often gets rewritten by some corporate proxies; when that happens guests see a blank join anchor. Our standard playbook is to: create a new host-owned ICS and also include the Zoom link in the invite body.
- I can generate the sanitized invite from my account (host-owned) and include AtlasHealth IT on the CC so they can whitelist that host/email.
- If AtlasHealth prefers we can also do a calendarless RSVP: we send a plain email confirmation with the Zoom link and put the meeting on our side only; that avoids their calendar policy but removes RSVP visibility.

Kim — I'll prepare the new invite for Thu 11:15 PT and CC it to their IT. Lauren, can you confirm if we want to use the Redwood-hosted Zoom (zoom@redwood.com) or Ben's account (ben.carter@redwood.com) for the host? Ben's might be easier to whitelist but Redwood-hosted is the standard.

-Ben
